steps.name: Require exactly one evaluation subject
steps.run:
count="$(jq 'length' <<<"$WORK")"
test "$count" = "1" || { echo "Expected exactly one Jev subject, got $count"; exit 1; }

steps.name: Materialize, evaluate and validate using trusted evaluator
Verify living-doc impact contract
steps.run:
body="$(jq -r '.pull_request.body // ""' "$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH")"
classification="$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | sed -n 's/^\*\*Classification:\*\*[[:space:]]*\(CURRENT_SYSTEM_CHANGED\|CURRENT_SYSTEM_NOT_CHANGED\)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' | head -n 1)"

if [ -z "$classification" ]; then
  echo "PR body must declare exactly one living-doc impact classification on the **Classification:** line."
  echo "Allowed values: CURRENT_SYSTEM_CHANGED | CURRENT_SYSTEM_NOT_CHANGED"
  exit 1
fi

count="$(printf '%s\n' "$body" | sed -n 's/^\*\*Classification:\*\*[[:space:]]*\(CURRENT_SYSTEM_CHANGED\|CURRENT_SYSTEM_NOT_CHANGED\)[[:space:]]*$/\1/p' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
if [ "$count" != "1" ]; then
  echo "PR body must contain exactly one living-doc impact classification; found $count."
  exit 1
fi

echo "living-doc impact: $classification"

if [ "$classification" = "CURRENT_SYSTEM_CHANGED" ]; then
  git fetch --no-tags origin "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
  changed="$(git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")"
  printf '%s\n' "$changed"
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -q '^docs/living/system/'; then
    echo "CURRENT_SYSTEM_CHANGED requires affected docs/living/system/* updates in the same PR."
    exit 1
  fi
fi

echo "Living-doc impact declaration gate passed. Semantic truth of the classification remains a review responsibility."

steps.name: Report Blackboard gate mode
steps.run:
work_count="$(jq 'length' <<<"$WORK")"
publication_count="$(jq 'length' <<<"$PUBLICATIONS")"
supersession_count="$(jq 'length' <<<"$SUPERSESSIONS")"
if [ "$supersession_count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "::notice::Blackboard objective supersession verification required for $supersession_count subject(s)."
fi
if [ "$work_count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "::notice::Blackboard semantic judgment required for $work_count subject(s)."
elif [ "$publication_count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "::notice::Blackboard readiness publication verification required for $publication_count subject(s)."
else
  echo "::notice::No Blackboard semantic judgment required."
fi

steps.name: Require complete CI for exact PR head
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
  echo "::error::$*"
  exit 1
}

require_success() {
  stage="$1"
  result="$2"
  [ "$result" = "success" ] || fail "$stage must succeed; got $result"
}

assert_exact_subjects() {
  label="$1"
  payload="$2"
  bad="$(jq -r --arg sha "$PR_HEAD_SHA" '[.[] | select(.sha != $sha)] | length' <<<"$payload")"
  [ "$bad" = "0" ] || fail "$label contains subject SHA different from PR head $PR_HEAD_SHA"
}

require_success "living-doc-impact" "$LIVING_DOC_RESULT"
require_success "kernel" "$KERNEL_RESULT"
require_success "blackboard-gate" "$BLACKBOARD_RESULT"

assert_exact_subjects "blackboard work" "$WORK"
assert_exact_subjects "readiness publications" "$PUBLICATIONS"
assert_exact_subjects "objective supersessions" "$SUPERSESSIONS"

if [ "$(jq 'length' <<<"$WORK")" -gt 0 ]; then
  require_success "blackboard-jev" "$JEV_RESULT"
else
  echo "blackboard-jev not applicable: selector emitted no JEV work"
fi

if [ "$(jq 'length' <<<"$PUBLICATIONS")" -gt 0 ]; then
  require_success "readiness-verify" "$READINESS_RESULT"
else
  echo "readiness-verify not applicable: selector emitted no readiness publication"
fi

if [ "$(jq 'length' <<<"$SUPERSESSIONS")" -gt 0 ]; then
  require_success "objective-supersession-verify" "$SUPERSESSION_RESULT"
else
  echo "objective-supersession-verify not applicable: selector emitted no supersession"
fi

echo "MERGE_GATE_ACCEPT candidate=$PR_HEAD_SHA"
